page_title: MON 0-3 BAY | B. Monchengladbach v Bayern Munich 25/10/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+6' Leon Goretzka slides a brilliant pass into Lennart Karl (Bayern Munich), but his shot from inside the box goes a whisker over the crossbar.
90+5' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.

90+2' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) attempts to score as he rises near the penalty spot and heads the ball to the roof of the net. Moritz Nicolas displays brilliant reflexes and pulls off a comfortable save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
90+1' Konrad Laimer (Bayern Munich) struck the ball which rebounded to the edge of the box. His attempt went narrowly over the crossbar.
90+1' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.
90' 7 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Josip Stanisic (Bayern Munich) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety. The referee points to the corner flag and Bayern Munich will take a corner.
89' Lennart Karl (Bayern Munich) tries to find Raphael Guerreiro with a clever through ball from the corner of the box, but the defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance.
89' The ball possession at the moment is 18:82.
86' The attendance is 54042.
85' Lennart Karl (Bayern Munich) escapes his marker to meet a cross and heads to the middle of the goal, but the keeper pulls off an excellent reflex save to deny him.
84' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Rocco Reitz trots off the pitch and is replaced by Oscar Fraulo (B. Monchengladbach).
84' Eugen Polanski has decided to substitute Kevin Stoger and he is replaced by Giovanni Reyna (B. Monchengladbach).
83' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) tries to find Harry Kane, but he puts too much power on the pass.
82' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Josip Stanisic (Bayern Munich) comes onto the pitch for Tom Bischof.
80' 0 - 3 Goal - 0:3! Lennart Karl (Bayern Munich) gets a shot away from the edge of the box and scores into the top left corner. Raphael Guerreiro provided an assist for the goal.
76' Lennart Karl (Bayern Munich) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Luis Diaz.
75' It's time for a substitution. Joe Scally (B. Monchengladbach) comes on in place of Franck Honorat.
75' Referee Sascha Stegemann halts the game and wanders over to the touchline to talk to Eugen Polanski, then shows him a yellow.
75' Kevin Stoger (B. Monchengladbach) fails to convert the penalty kick! His effort hits the left post.
75' Here is a change. Luca Netz is going off and Eugen Polanski gives the last tactical orders to Lukas Ullrich (B. Monchengladbach).
74' Kevin Stoger (B. Monchengladbach) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
74' Tom Bischof (Bayern Munich) is given a fully deserved yellow card.
73' The B. Monchengladbach players are happy as the referee awards a PENALTY after the VAR review!
72' Referee Sascha Stegemann makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for B. Monchengladbach. Let’s see what happens!
71' Kevin Diks (B. Monchengladbach) breaks into the box and goes over after a challenge from an opposition player, but the ref signals NO penalty!
71' The corner from Kevin Stoger (B. Monchengladbach) is intercepted by the defence.

71' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. B. Monchengladbach have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.

69' 0 - 2 It's in the back of the net! Superb finishing from Raphael Guerreiro (Bayern Munich). Michael Olise plays a fantastic through ball and finds Raphael Guerreiro (Bayern Munich), who reacts quickly to get in front of the goalkeeper and fire a close-range shot into the bottom right corner. 0:2.
68' Konrad Laimer (Bayern Munich) serves up a nice cross, but Moritz Nicolas punches the ball away.
68' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) fires the ball towards goal from outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by one of his teammates.
68' Total attempts – 0:20. 0:7 - the latest stats for both teams in respect of shots on target.

67' Michael Olise sprays a wonderful pass out to Tom Bischof (Bayern Munich), who cannot get enough power or direction to cause Moritz Nicolas problems and the goalkeeper is able to watch the ball go just wide of the right post.
64' 0 - 1 Goal! Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) fires the rebound inside the right post after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 0:1.
64' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) inside the box following a slide rule pass.
63' That's the end of the game for Haris Tabakovic, who is replaced by Shuto Machino (B. Monchengladbach).
62' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) has a goal ruled out for offside!
61' A quickly taken corner by Bayern Munich.

61' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) strikes a promising volley towards goal, but one of the defenders is quick enough to step in and make a crucial block. Bayern Munich force their opponents to concede a corner.

60' Luis Diaz (Bayern Munich) meets a delivery on the edge of the penalty area and shoots towards to the bottom left corner. He didn't put enough power into the effort, though, and Moritz Nicolas pulls off an easy save.
60' Luis Diaz (Bayern Munich) wriggles into space and fires the ball from the edge of the area, but one of the defenders is there to block the effort.
59' Substitution. Nicolas Jackson leaves the pitch and is replaced by Serge Gnabry (Bayern Munich).
57' Great teamplay by B. Monchengladbach as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
56' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.
54' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
52' Luis Diaz (Bayern Munich) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The ball goes out of play and B. Monchengladbach will have a goal kick.

50' What a great touch by Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) as he controls a fine pass into the box and takes a shot to the bottom left corner, but an opposing player makes a clearance. Great defending. Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) collects a rebound and his promising attempt heads towards the left side of the goal, but Moritz Nicolas keeps it out with an amazing save.
49' A pass from Luis Diaz (Bayern Munich) is intercepted by Moritz Nicolas and the move breaks down.
48' CHANCE! Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) fires just over the crossbar from inside the box after running onto a splendid pass from Harry Kane.
46' The need to improve in the second half has brought about a change. Sacha Boey (Bayern Munich) comes off for Raphael Guerreiro.
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Vincent Kompany gives a chance to Konrad Laimer and Dayot Upamecano (Bayern Munich) is off.
46' The whistle blows and Sascha Stegemann starts the second half.
45+6' The end of the first half.
45+5' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) sends a cross in and finds Harry Kane inside the box, but one of the defenders steps in and clears the danger.
45+4' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) produces an effort from the edge of the box, but doesn't hit the ball properly and sends it yards wide of the right post.
45+3' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) crosses the ball into the box from the free kick, but the defence clears the danger.
45+2' Sascha Stegemann blows his whistle and signals a foul after Kevin Stoger (B. Monchengladbach) brought his opponent down. There is a free kick near the sideline to Bayern Munich.
45' We will have 5 min. of added time.
45' The resulting corner comes to nothing as Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) sends it out of play.

45' Close! Tom Bischof (Bayern Munich) picks up a pass and produces a ferocious strike towards the right post, but the goalkeeper gets his fingertips to the ball to keep it out. Bayern Munich have a corner.
42' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) receives a diagonal pass, bursts into the box and shoots towards the bottom left corner. Moritz Nicolas is well positioned, though, and it's a comfortable save.
41' Half-chance! Tom Bischof (Bayern Munich) plays a pass into the box, but Moritz Nicolas reacts well to snuff out the attack.
41' Sacha Boey nearly gets in a one-on-one with the goalkeeper after a defence-splitting pass from Nicolas Jackson (Bayern Munich), but one of the defenders makes a clearance to snuff out the chance.
40' Luis Diaz (Bayern Munich) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Moritz Nicolas, who smothers the ball.
38' This is a yellow card! Luis Diaz (Bayern Munich) is not happy with the decision, but from our point of view it was clear.
38' Tom Bischof (Bayern Munich) attempts to find Nicolas Jackson with a delicate little through ball from inside the box, but one of the defending players makes a timely intervention.
34' Luis Diaz (Bayern Munich) receives a pass and unleashes a shot which goes well wide of the right post.
33' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 0:3. The shots on goal statistics – 0:0.
31' Luis Diaz picks out Dayot Upamecano (Bayern Munich), who makes a total mess of his shot from mid-range and sends the ball high over the bar.

29' Kevin Stoger (B. Monchengladbach) tries to take the opposition by surprise with a quick free kick into the box. Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Jonas Urbig intercepts the ball.
28' Dayot Upamecano (Bayern Munich) makes it easy for the referee to show him a yellow card.
28' Haris Tabakovic (B. Monchengladbach) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
27' Haris Tabakovic (B. Monchengladbach) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
24' Tom Bischof (Bayern Munich) and Nicolas Jackson attempt to exchange short two-yard passes, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
23' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich), but one of the defenders gets it clear.
22' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender. Now Bayern Munich have a corner.
19' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) delivers a poor cross from a free kick as one of the defenders comfortably clears it away.
19' After VAR review the ref signals the yellow card is cancelled but now issues a red. Jens Castrop (B. Monchengladbach) has to leave the pitch!

16' It's been a while since that contentious challenge by Jens Castrop (B. Monchengladbach), but referee Sascha Stegemann must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review and it could result in a red card!
15' Jens Castrop (B. Monchengladbach) can count himself lucky for not being sent off after only receiving a caution from the referee.
14' The Bayern Munich players are exchanging some short passes.
13' Sacha Boey (Bayern Munich) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
12' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
11' Kevin Stoger (B. Monchengladbach) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
9' The resulting corner from Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) is cleared by the opposition's defence.
9' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders. Corner kick. Bayern Munich will have an opportunity.
8' A cross from Luis Diaz (Bayern Munich) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety. Bayern Munich get a corner.
7' Jens Castrop (B. Monchengladbach) is penalised for holding. Sascha Stegemann signals a set piece.

7' Philipp Sander (B. Monchengladbach) plays a long ball to Franck Honorat, but the defence is well organised and manages to get it clear. The ball is out of play. B. Monchengladbach will take a throw-in.
6' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) clearly handles the ball, but he is surprised when the referee blows his whistle.
3' Jens Castrop (B. Monchengladbach) sends a long cross over to Franck Honorat, but Jonas Urbig comes forward to gather the ball.
1' What a huge chance for Luis Diaz (Bayern Munich). He collects a precise pass inside the box and slices a shot that goes a whisker wide of the left post.
